nodes.name: Code — build message from template
nodes.notes: Zero Claude calls. Picks template variant, injects owner name + area + market data point. Language detected by Arabic regex on owner name.

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  o.*, 
  m.avg_sale_price, 
  m.avg_rent_annual, 
  m.avg_price_sqft, 
  m.data_date
FROM owners o 
LEFT JOIN market_data m 
  ON m.area = o.area 
  AND m.beds = o.beds 
  AND m.building_name IS NULL
WHERE o.status = 'new' 
ORDER BY o.priority_score DESC 
LIMIT 5

nodes.notes: Updates status AND language detected by regex. No extra API call needed.
